name: Maximum Security & Patrol Services Ltd
primary_cta: Call 242-394-5425 (second line 242-393-7206); proposal builder writes the sentence to read out (no email published)
brand_truth: A Nassau firm founded in 1993 by Byron C. Rodgers with not more than a dozen fully trained officers, supplying officers, patrols, alarm monitoring, investigations and consultancy from one office on Carib Road.
buyer: Facilities, operations and procurement managers at banks, retailers, offices and government in Nassau, plus property managers and private clients, comparing 2-4 security firms and fearing no-shows, turnover and slow response.

direction.why: Security is bought by people who fear the hours they cannot see; a day-into-night film shows coverage instead of listing it, and the night-blue ground with brass light is the job itself. The 1993 story and services sit on the bone light section.

big_idea: One Nassau day of protection, 06:00 to 03:00: a pinned film where the photograph and the light change hour by hour, each hour carrying one real service.
concept_type: brochure: services + request a security proposal (call)
tier_why: Photography film with opacity crossfades and slow push-in; no WebGL needed.

pitch_line: Your domain is gone and buyers find a fax number; this shows a procurement manager, hour by hour, what your officers do, and gets them to call Carib Road.
